calls.title: MC Sonae<>GrowthBook - Discussion
calls.summary: GrowthBook team (Jake Heier and Logan Bates) discussed with Ágata Marinho of MC Sonae an A/B test plan for placing brand content between conversion carousels on PDPs, worrying it might hurt conversion. They agreed to run an ABC test (control + two positions) instead of a two-phase test for better statistical validity, and addressed GDPR and data privacy concerns regarding GrowthBook’s managed warehouse.
